title: boot.t1 re-blesses all 100 per-tick hashes, not just the catalog_hash header line
detail: Violates the re-bless guard: 'the light demos must show ZERO sim change — their .t1 hash-line shifts must be EXACTLY the catalog_hash header line, no per-tick line shifts.' All 100 tick lines re-hashed = unaccounted drift = a blocker.
recommended_fix: Regenerate boot.t1 so only the catalog_hash line changes; before re-blessing, identify what sim change re-hashed every tick.

title: boot ships no PNG re-bless although scope lists boot (.t1 + .log.bin + .png) and reason (b) repainted all pipe demos
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/boot.log.bin b/goldens/boot.log.bin
Binary files a/goldens/boot.log.bin and b/goldens/boot.log.bin differ
diff --git a/goldens/boot.t1 b/goldens/boot.t1
detail: Scope: 'goldens/boot|bundle|demolish|draw|ecmp|flow|lose|place (.t1 + .log.bin + .png)'; canon repaint covers 'all pipe demos'. The chunk re-blesses boot's .t1 and .log.bin but no boot PNG appears, while every other demo's PNGs changed.
recommended_fix: Verify whether goldens/boot/*.png exists; re-bless it under the canon repaint, or drop .png from the chunk scope if boot renders nothing.
